title: Arbok’s Warning Face May Have Over 20 Versions
premise: Arbok’s terrifying belly pattern went from six confirmed variations to over 20 possible arrangements.
audiencePromise: Watch a regional rumor become six confirmed patterns, then explode into over 20 possible warning faces.
openLoop: Why were six patterns confirmed when Arbok may have over 20 arrangements?
payoff: Arbok’s belly is not one fixed warning face: research moved from six confirmed variants to over 20 possible arrangements.
engagementQuestion: One frightening face or twenty possible ones: which works better?

voice.instructions: Start hushed and suspicious. Build urgency as the pattern cards multiply. Land the final count with sharp surprise, then ask the closing question with a playful challenge.

scenes.headline: ONE FACE. OVER TWENTY VERSIONS.
scenes.narration: Arbok's warning face may hide over twenty versions.
scenes.caption: ONE BELLY PATTERN. MORE THAN 20 POSSIBILITIES.

scenes.headline: THEY CHANGED BY AREA
scenes.narration: Reports said its belly markings differed from area to area.
scenes.caption: THE WARNING FACE WAS NEVER IDENTICAL EVERYWHERE.

scenes.headline: SIX WERE CONFIRMED
scenes.narration: Study confirmed six frightening variations, making the rumor feel real.
scenes.caption: SIX PATTERN CARDS LOCK INTO PLACE.

scenes.headline: IT MAKES FOES FLEE
scenes.narration: Weak foes flee when Arbok shows its frightening face-like belly pattern.
scenes.caption: THIS IS NOT DECORATION. IT IS A WARNING.

scenes.headline: OVER 20 ARRANGEMENTS
scenes.narration: Latest research found over twenty possible arrangements on Arbok's stomach.
scenes.caption: SIX BECOMES A SWARM OF MORE THAN TWENTY.

scenes.headline: ONE FACE OR TWENTY?
scenes.narration: One frightening face or twenty possible ones: which works better?
scenes.caption: ONE COBRA. HOW MANY WARNING FACES?
